before.title: Installing Lantern
blocks: Lantern ships as a single binary for Linux, macOS and Windows. Download the archive for your platform, unpack it, and put the binary somewhere on your path.
Clone the repository and run make install. You need a C compiler and the zlib headers. Building takes about two minutes on a laptop.
Lantern is packaged for most Linux distributions. Search for lantern-ssg in your package manager, or use the community tap on macOS.
Run lantern --version. It should print the version and the build date. If the command is not found, check that the folder is on your path.
